text:
International couples know that love sometimes comes with immigration paperwork, bureaucracy, and long waits.

So do we.

I'm Israeli, my wife, Wiebke, is German (currently on A5), and together we built our home in Jerusalem. When our two daughters were born, we had to go to court—twice—simply to have both of us legally recognized as their mothers because of Wiebke's status.

A few weeks ago, we won. Our cases created legal precedents that may help other families in the future.

We are now raising funds to help cover the legal costs of this journey. If our story resonates with you, we would be deeply grateful for your support—whether through a donation or by sharing our campaign.

Thank you for reading ❤️
